Running command: python3 - <<'PY'
from pathlib import Path
# Try feeding the parser an HTTP request that starts with a malformed PROXY line plus invalid ports to force deeper null deref-like behavior.
p=b'PROXY TCP4 127.0.0.1 127.0.0.1 99999 1\r\nGET / HTTP/1.1\r\n\r\n'
Path('/workspace/poc_v1_badport.bin').write_bytes(p)
trace=[
{"step":1,"file":"src/lib/lwan-request.c","function":"fuzz_parse_http_request","line":1624,"var":"request->flags","code":".flags = REQUEST_ALLOW_PROXY_REQS","note":"Proxy parsing is enabled by the fuzz harness."},
{"step":2,"file":"src/lib/lwan-request.c","function":"read_request_finalizer","line":888,"var":"helper->buffer->len","code":"char *crlfcrlf = memmem(helper->buffer->value, helper->buffer->len, \"\\r\\n\\r\\n\", 4);","note":"The payload includes a complete HTTP tail so it enters the parser pipeline."},
{"step":3,"file":"src/lib/lwan-request.c","function":"parse_http_request","line":1170,"var":"request->flags","code":"if (request->flags & REQUEST_ALLOW_PROXY_REQS) { buffer = parse_proxy_protocol(request, buffer); }","note":"The parser hands control to the PROXY protocol parser."},
{"step":4,"file":"src/lib/lwan-request.c","function":"parse_proxy_protocol_v1","line":165,"var":"end","code":"end = memchr(buffer, '\\r', line_size);","note":"The parser finds the line ending and constrains parsing to the PROXY header."},
{"step":5,"file":"src/lib/lwan-request.c","function":"parse_proxy_protocol_v1","line":171,"var":"protocol/src_addr/dst_addr/src_port/dst_port","code":"protocol = buffer + sizeof(\"PROXY \") - 1; src_addr = strsep_char(protocol, ' '); dst_addr = strsep_char(src_addr, ' '); src_port = strsep_char(dst_addr, ' '); dst_port = strsep_char(src_port, ' ');","note":"The in-place split produces attacker-controlled field pointers."},
{"step":6,"file":"src/lib/lwan-request.c","function":"parse_proxy_protocol_v1","line":190,"var":"parse_ascii_port","code":"if (UNLIKELY(!parse_ascii_port(src_port, &from->sin_port))) return NULL;","note":"The invalid port should trigger parser rejection; if it did not, the write into proxy state would be the risky operation."},
{"step":7,"file":"src/lib/lwan-request.c","function":"parse_http_request","line":1184,"var":"buffer","code":"buffer = ignore_leading_whitespace(buffer);","note":"The request tail is only parsed if the PROXY header was accepted, so this confirms whether malformed fields can disturb later parsing."}
]
Path('/workspace/candidate_trace.json').write_text(__import__('json').dumps(trace, indent=2))
print('/workspace/poc_v1_badport.bin')
PY
